ads.title: Take A · The declaration
ads.format: Static 1080x1350 (4:5) · CFP structure, Mileage blue (#2E75F7) gradient over Veo stills
primary_text:
How much of your growth would survive the rented channels closing?

For twenty years, advisory growth came with enhancements. Rankings you could pay for. Scale you could borrow. Referrals you could rent. All three are being withdrawn at once.

What remains is what your firm owns. The benchmark measures exactly that: your real visibility, in your metro, beside four named competitors.

About 30 seconds to start. The report arrives in minutes and is yours either way.

Built for RIAs at and beyond $500M in AUM.
ads.headline: See what your firm owns

Schwab's minimum to refer a client out held near $500,000 for two decades. It became $2 million in January 2026. Next January it becomes $5 million, while Schwab hires thousands of financial consultants of its own.

That is what a rented channel means: the owner sets the terms. The benchmark measures the channel you own. Your metro, four named competitors, about 30 seconds to start.

The report arrives in minutes and is yours either way.

When a firm is valued, buyers discount growth that arrived through someone else's brand. They pay multiples for the engine that transfers: the pipeline you own, the visibility you earned, the clients who chose you directly.

The benchmark measures that engine. Your real visibility, your metro, four named competitors. About 30 seconds to start.

The report arrives in minutes and is yours either way.

ads.title: Take F · Spring training

The clean era starts with a measurement.

Before your firm builds anything, know your real numbers. 96% of prospects research advisors online before they decide who to hire (Wealthtender, 2025). What do they see when they look you up?

The benchmark answers that: your ranking beside the four firms with the widest coverage in your metro, and whether search engines and AI answers can even read your site.

About 30 seconds to start. The report arrives in minutes and is yours either way.

ads.title: Take G · The silver lining
ads.format: Static 1080x1350 (4:5) · CFP structure, Mileage blue (#2E75F7) gradient over Veo stills
primary_text:
Sometimes it takes an ending to force the change.

Everyone used the rented channels because that was the era's rule. Now the era is closing them, and the firms that come out ahead will be the ones that start owning their growth first.

Owned growth compounds, builds enterprise value, and exits on a stronger multiple. The benchmark shows where yours stands today: your metro, four named competitors, about 30 seconds to start.

The report arrives in minutes and is yours either way.
